haze.options.title: Haze Settings
haze.options.enabled.tooltip: Turns all of Haze's fog and mist on or off.
haze.options.intensity.tooltip: How thick the fog gets when it rolls in.
haze.options.frequency.tooltip: How often a calm night ends in a foggy morning.
haze.options.depth.tooltip: How high the fog layer reaches above the lowlands.
haze.options.morning_fog.tooltip: Some nights fog settles into the valleys, thickest around sunrise, and burns off over the morning. More likely after rain and in humid places, never in deserts.
haze.options.always_fog.tooltip: Keeps a layer of fog in the valleys all day and night, in every biome. Intensity and Depth set how thick it is.
haze.options.rain_mist.tooltip: A light grey mist hangs in the air while it rains and lingers a little after.
haze.options.swamp_mist.tooltip: Swamps and mangroves always have a low mist, heavier at night.
haze.options.sun_glow.tooltip: Morning fog glows warm where the low sun shines through it.
haze.options.wisps.tooltip: The fog drifts in slow, uneven wisps instead of a flat layer.
haze.options.cave_fog.tooltip: Caves fill with a dim, cool haze that gets darker the deeper you go.
haze.options.underwater.tooltip: Water gets a soft tint that darkens with depth, follows the biome's water color, and has drifting specks.
haze.options.keys.tooltip: Set keys to toggle Haze or open these settings.
haze.options.reset.tooltip: Puts every Haze setting back to its default.
